title: Decisions and next review
summary: Owner decisions, current production rules and review items. The latest Blender source policy, FBX configuration, intentional UV exceptions and resolved texture cleanup are recorded below.

items.title: Confirmed / environment first
items.body: 12 November 2026 — Owner: environment first, currently Basement. Work in the four allowed maps. New and modified art assets stay under `/Game/Art`. The owner explicitly permits overwriting existing art assets when the completed change list identifies them. Characters, weapons and UI stay deferred.

items.title: Confirmed / density and intentional tileable exceptions
items.body: 12 November 2026 — Owner: use 256 px/m for some modular structures and 512 px/m for simple props. Some floors and ceilings intentionally use another density to match their specific tileable texture. Preserve those UV scales and material tiling; do not normalize them to the nominal values. The sampled concrete floor at about 128 px/m is an intentional exception, not an outstanding fix.

items.title: Implemented / first Basement service-area pass
items.body:
**Owner authorization, 12 November 2026:** execute the Overview sequence; existing assets may be overwritten if marked afterward.

**Agent-selected implementation:** an olive/cream equipment sign, reused fluorescent fixture and one 3900 K rectangular task light at the counter. Preserve the original barred delivery mechanism and neglected corridor.

**Verified:** three matched actual gameplay pairs; saved/reloaded materials; original geometry and source blend retained.

**Owner aesthetic acceptance:** pending review of Pass 01. Sign wording and exact light balance remain editable.

items.title: Verified / representative modular contract
items.body:
Wall 400 × 400 × 15 cm; corner 385 × 400 × 15 cm; floor 400 × 400 × 15 cm. Unit scales and common edge pivots verified. A corner’s 385 cm length plus the adjoining wall’s 15 cm thickness completes the 400 cm grid.

Copied Blender → FBX → Unreal import/reimport passed for four types. Corrected the trial export from a 100× unit mismatch and verified UVs and vertex-paint alpha by exporting the native copy back to Blender. Initial imports need explicit vertex-color Replace; reimport may preserve existing paint.

Source contract and exact test paths are in Pass 01 and the project MODULE_CONTRACT.md.

items.title: Resolved / obsolete texture references removed
items.body: 12 November 2026 — Owner confirmed that obsolete texture references in `Enviroment_Assets` were removed after replacement by an atlas. A fresh read-only check of both saved sources found **zero missing unpacked file images**. The old Bars, Chains and Old_Elevator_Door warning is closed; do not regenerate or relink those retired textures. Neither source was saved by the audit.

items.title: Later / window ownership
items.body: Owner raised moving windows from the prop file into the modular structure file. Keep as a future library decision; no asset migration has been performed.

items.title: Optional / Designer graph connection
items.body: The existing Adobe batch tools work. An in-app read-only Python audit is prepared. Run it when interactive graph inspection or editing is the next concrete task. No additional Designer MCP or runtime Unreal Substance plugin was installed.

items.title: Verified / lighting is assembled in both review maps
items.body: Main_Lights is Always Loaded and visible in saved Basement and LaCarlota. It was already present in the live LaCarlota session when work began; the level was saved without adding a duplicate. A real LaCarlota PIE audit confirmed the streamed directional light and the player pawn. Global Main_Lights content was not changed.

items.title: Confirmed / author in the existing Blender files
items.body: 12 November 2026 — Owner: Create new structures and shop assets inside `Assets/Building/Interior_Building.blend`; create individual environment assets and props inside `Assets/Enviroment_Assets/Enviroment_Assets.blend`. Paths are relative to `D:/GameJam/Total (in)Sanitation/`. Use these existing files and their collections. Create a new `.blend` only when the task explicitly requires one. Historical Pass 01 sources are retained as editable evidence.

items.title: Confirmed / Super Duper Batch Exporter settings
items.alt: Owner-supplied Super Duper Batch Exporter settings for Blender to Unreal FBX delivery
items.body:
**Owner configuration, 12 November 2026.** Use Super Duper Batch Exporter: FBX, **Parent Objects**, **Visible**, filename **`$OBJ`**, preset **`Unreal_Only_FBX`**, Apply Modifiers enabled, **Mesh only**, Transform on Export disabled, Create LOD disabled. Set Directory for the asset destination; the pictured `//Delivery\Basement\Shop\` is an example.

The installed preset was read locally: scale 1, apply units, `FBX_SCALE_NONE`, forward **`-Z`**, up **`Y`**, no animation. The earlier direct-export trial used different axes and remains historical evidence. The exact addon/preset round trip is still to be checked on the next asset delivery. Full contract: `projects/total-insanitation/BLENDER_WORKFLOW.md` and Tools.
